depiction.primary_object: rectangular speech bubble containing a five-bar audio waveform
modifiers: five vertical soundwave bars inside bubble
depiction.composition: single outlined speech bubble with centered symmetrical waveform, front view

ambiguity: Could be confused with a generic audio equalizer or podcast icon if the speech bubble tail is missed at very small sizes.

modifier_semantics.modifier: five vertical soundwave bars inside bubble
modifier_semantics.meaning: audio, voice recording, or spoken sound rather than written text

reasoning: A speech bubble containing a vertical audio waveform unmistakably represents a voice message, audio note, voicemail, or spoken chat. It fits everyday tasks like listening to or sending voice notes, checking voicemails, and transcribing voice memos, while standing cleanly apart from plain text-bubble and standalone microphone icons.
